title.zh: 根据验证证据决定课题走向
title.en: Decide the Next Step from Validation Evidence

label.zh: 同条件验证：检查安全、质量、收益与成本
label.en: Matched Tests: Safety, Quality, Benefit, Cost

label.zh: 通过且有收益 → 申请下一阶段
label.en: Pass with Benefit → Seek Next-Stage Approval

label.zh: 缺少证据 → 只批准最小实验
安全失败、无收益或超预算 → 停止
label.en: Unsafe, No Benefit, or Over Budget → Stop
